title: File Handling
intro: Learn the basic ideas of File Handling in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: open()
items.text: open() creates a file object for reading or writing a file.

items.heading: Read mode
items.text: The r mode opens a file for reading.

items.heading: Write mode
items.text: The w mode writes a file and replaces existing content.

items.heading: Append mode
items.text: The a mode adds new content at the end of a file.

items.heading: read()
items.text: read() returns file content as a string.

items.heading: readlines()
items.text: readlines() reads the lines and returns them as a list.

items.heading: write()
items.text: write() writes text to a file and returns the number of characters written.

items.heading: with open()
items.text: Using with automatically closes the file when the block ends, even if an exception occurs.
items.code:
with open("data.txt") as f:
    text = f.read()

items.heading: encoding
items.text: Specifying an encoding such as UTF-8 helps Python interpret text correctly.

items.heading: FileNotFoundError
items.text: Reading a file that does not exist can raise FileNotFoundError.

items.heading: Closing files
items.text: A file should be closed after use. The with statement is the preferred simple approach.
